name: Probability bars carry text labels, not color alone
description: The consensus probability bars must convey their values through text (outcome name plus percentage), not color or length alone, so the data is accessible to screen-reader and color-blind users. Bars with no associated readable label fail.

planSteps.description: Navigate to the homepage and open a match detail page
Click the Betting Odds tab and inspect each of the three probability bars

Verify each probability bar has an associated text label identifying its outcome (home/draw/away) and its percentage value, available as visible text or an accessible name (aria-label / aria-valuetext / adjacent text). A bar conveying its value only through width or color, with no readable label, fails.
